item.title: EU/EEA banks continue to display resilience amid sovereign debt pressures, borrower vulnerabilities and rising cyber threats
item.description: The EBA today published its Autumn 2026 Risk Assessment Report (RAR) together with a thematic note on lending to small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) and the results of its Autumn 2026 Risk Assessment Questionnaire (RAQ). The findings show that EU/EEA banks remain resilient, supported by strong capital, liquidity and profitability, while continuing to increase financing to the economy. At the same time, geopolitical uncertainty, sensitivity to sovereign debt repricing, growing interconnectedness within the financial sector and evolving operational threats warrant… — Thématique finance ; source jugée fiable (european banking authority) ; impact marché.
